title: Geo-ADAPT-VQE: Quantum Information Metric-Aware Circuit Optimization for Quantum Chemistry
summary: Adaptive ansatz construction has emerged as a powerful technique for reducing circuit depth and improving optimization efficiency in variational quantum eigensolvers. However, existing adaptive methods, including ADAPT-VQE, rely solely on first-order gradients and therefore ignore the underlying geometry of the quantum state space, limiting both convergence behavior and operator-selection efficiency.
